configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Release build with vcpkg, mirrors what CI and packaging consume.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Debug build of mo2-server and salma_tests with the same triplet. The FOMOD engine is Rust: debug it with cargo, not this preset.

configurePresets.name: ci-release
configurePresets.description: Release for CI. Inherits default, so edits to default reach CI too; the separate name exists so a workflow never has to spell out a preset that local tooling also owns.

configurePresets.name: ci-debug
configurePresets.description: Same as debug; named explicitly for CI predictability.

configurePresets.name: compile-db
configurePresets.description: Ninja-based configure whose only purpose is to emit a real compile_commands.json for clang-tidy/clangd. Shares vcpkg_installed/ with the default preset so vcpkg does not re-install. Never built directly; only configured.

buildPresets.name: tests-only
buildPresets.description: Skips mo2-server, and with it the post-build copy of mo2-salma.dll into build/bin/Release, so the SalmaEngine tests fail on ensure_loaded() unless that DLL is already there.

buildPresets.name: ci-tests
buildPresets.description: Skips mo2-server, and with it the post-build copy of mo2-salma.dll into build/bin/Release, so the SalmaEngine tests fail on ensure_loaded() unless that DLL is already there.
